gui.selective_enchantment_transfer.title: Selective Transfer
gui.selective_enchantment_transfer.mode_: The enchantments leave the item and go to the new book.
The item keeps its enchantments. Costs %s× the normal price.
message.selective_enchantment_transfer.n: You don't have enough experience levels.
message.selective_enchantment_transfer.c: Only operators can change the settings.
gui.selective_enchantment_transfer.confi: On servers only operators can save changes. Shift+click goes back.
Transfers cost experience levels. Turn it off to make them free.
Multiplies the price of every enchantment (×1 = default balance, free = no cost).
Maximum total cost of a single transfer, in levels.
Minimum number of enchantments an item needs for this mod to take over the anvil.
Enables Copy mode: the item keeps its enchantments and the new book gets a copy.
Copying costs this many times the normal price.
Allow copying treasure enchantments (Mending, Soul Speed...). They always wear down the item when copied.
Anvil sound when a transfer is completed.
message.selective_enchantment_transfer.t: Selective Transfer: this item has %s enchantment(s) and at least %s are needed.
advancements.selective_enchantment_trans: Move enchantments from an item to a book at the anvil
Copy enchantments without losing them from the original
Split the enchantments of an enchanted book
Pay 30 or more levels in a single transfer
You need an item with durability to copy this one
message.selective_enchantment_transfer.n: The item doesn't have enough durability for this copy.
gui.selective_enchantment_transfer.confi: Copying wears down the durability of the source item (30% per enchantment; 35% for strong ones like Mending). Enchanted books can't copy strong enchantments.
Multiplies all wear values (x1 = as listed in the config file).
Per-enchantment prices, blocked enchantments and wear values are edited in the config file.
Every copied enchantment costs the source item this % of its max durability (tools and armor). Strong enchantments use the larger value.
